# {{LocalName}}

This repo is the local companion to the code repo `../{{RepoName}}`. The two
repos form a **repo pair**. These instructions apply to every coding agent
(Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or any other) that works in either repo.

| Repo | Path | What goes there |
|---|---|---|
| Code repo | `../{{RepoName}}` | Code changes, branches, commits, and pull requests. |
| Local repo (this one) | `../{{LocalName}}` | Records *about* the work: session logs, decisions, plans, issue and PR drafts, memory, scripts, and secrets. This repo is never pushed upstream. |

## Rules

1. Write and edit code in `../{{RepoName}}` only. Do not put code changes here.
2. Do not add any record, note, or plan to `../{{RepoName}}`. The pair files in
   that repo (`AGENTS.md` or `AGENTS.override.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`,
   `.agents/rules/repo-pair.md`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.codex/`) are
   excluded with `.git/info/exclude`. Never stage, commit, or "clean up" them.
3. Do not save memory in your tool's own memory store (Claude auto memory,
   Codex memories, Antigravity Knowledge Items, or a similar feature). Write
   what you learn to `memory/` in this repo, so that every agent can read it.
4. Read `memory/` and the newest files in `sessions/` and `decisions/` at the
   start of a session, before you change anything.
5. Use the templates in `templates/` when you create a record.

## Record keeping

| Record | Location and file name | When |
|---|---|---|
| Session log | `sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-<agent>-<topic>.md` | Create one at the start of each session. Update it before you stop. If a log for the same day and topic exists, append to it. |
| Decision | `decisions/NNNN-<short-title>.md` (next free number, 4 digits) | When you or the user choose between approaches, so the reason is not lost. |
| Plan | `plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md` | Before multi-step work. Update the status as you go. |
| Issue | `issues/<short-title>.md` | For a bug, gap, or follow-up that is not fixed in this session. |
| Pull request | `pull-requests/<branch-name>.md` | Draft the PR title and description here before you open the PR. |
| Memory | `memory/<topic>.md` | For facts that stay true across sessions: build commands, conventions, gotchas, user preferences. Keep one topic per file and update it instead of adding duplicates. |

`<agent>` is a short lowercase name: `claude`, `codex`, `antigravity`, and so on.
